limits: Original nine producer functions, size helpers and B05ED0/B06370/B05670 execute in isolated Unicorn memory. Declared preallocated three-page ring; no growth, allocation, retry wait, consumer, hardware or historical game process.
Win32 critical-section leaves and CRT memcpy are explicit adapters. No producer/queue body is replaced. Stack padding is supplied by three diagnostic seeds, not a canonical default.
Current Rust comparison can qualify transport only; this receipt does not implement any ordinary current producer or command body.
Ten concrete profiles do not include opcode20; bounded selected calls cannot prove its global absence.
Actual existing enqueue/enqueue_with_wait/owned-page code compiled unchanged. Native-built packets supplied as input; no ordinary Rust producer or command20 body implemented.
Fixed three-page ring covers fit/exact-end/advance; allocation/retry waits/consumers deliberately fail if unexpectedly invoked.
18 native no-packet cases have no ordinary current producer to compare here and are explicitly excluded from transport replay.

REA analyses nineteen selected functions from the original whole PE; recovered declarations are not authoritative source signatures. Incoming references outside direct E8/E9 are retained as other_reference, not declared decoded calls.
Original producer20 is unresolved, not globally absent. Nine executed producer entries do not cover all sixteen immediate callers or indirect/tailcall routes.

Initial bytearray API error, preparation encoding typo, invalid aliased capture and two failed Rust probes retained. Corrected native receipt and final Rust probe alone are qualified. No product source changed.
Sixteen direct B05ED0 callers in selected PE; immediate AX/CX definitions and packet-word stores recouped against original bytes. Nine producers dynamically exercised; seven remain static.
No opcode20 among these seventeen assignments. No claim about indirect calls, alternate enqueue entrypoints, dynamically generated packets, dead code or other builds.
